nom: Clinique Superdefense City Block Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Daily Energy + Face Protector Primer

segments.dry: Reports from reviewers with dry skin split sharply: several, including one who also calls her skin sensitive and mature, say it hydrates well, calms redness, and never leaves her greasy; one reviewer with normal-to-dry skin disagrees strongly, saying this version leaves her skin oily, sticky, and heavy compared to the discontinued formula she used for over a decade.
segments.oily: The two reviewers with oily skin, including one who is also sensitive and acne-prone, report a soft matte finish that disappears into the skin rather than adding shine, though one flags it as more hit-or-miss for oily-combination skin generally.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin disagree: several, including some who are also dry or sensitive, report it balances their skin and works well once paired with a moisturizer underneath; one reviewer with combination skin found it simply made her skin oily and considered the purchase wasted money.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea or acne, consistently report no irritation, burning, or breakouts, with some specifically crediting it with calming redness; no reviewer with self-described sensitive skin reports a bad reaction to it.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes normal-to-dry skin is also the clearest dissenter overall, saying the current formula leaves her skin oily and heavy where the discontinued version she used for years did not.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who names mature, sensitive skin uses it as both moisturizer and sunscreen, reporting it calms her redness and causes no burning despite regular sun exposure.

concerns.aging: The two reviewers who mention an anti-aging effect say it gives a more youthful appearance and doesn't settle into or emphasize their wrinkles; neither reports a downside on this point.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers disagree here: several say it hydrates well or doubles as their moisturizer, especially when they have dry or sensitive skin, while a couple report the opposite, describing their skin as left extremely dry, in one case even after increasing moisturizer use to compensate. Many reviewers on both sides note it works best applied over a moisturizer rather than alone.
concerns.redness: Reviewers managing rosacea or general redness consistently report calmer skin, less redness, and no burning, even with heavy sun exposure or sweating; no reviewer reports the product making their redness worse.
concerns.spots: Reviewers who have used it for multiple years report no new dark spots or hyperpigmentation, and one specifically credits it with keeping her existing dark spots from getting worse.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no breakouts or clogged pores, some contrasting it favorably with other sunscreens that did break them out; one reviewer disagrees, describing a severe breakout after using it.
concerns.oiliness: Reports split clearly along how the product is used: several reviewers, including some with oily skin, describe a matte, non-greasy finish, while others, including ones with normal-to-dry or combination skin, say it left them feeling oily, sticky, or greasy, particularly when applied without a moisturizer underneath first.

aspects.libelle: Many miss the discontinued original formula
Thick, heavy texture, hard to spread
Orange tint sheers out for most tones
Tint or cast shows on some deeper tones
Works best applied over a moisturizer
Doubles well as a makeup primer

extraits.texte: This cream is the worst out of all options at Clinique. I have been Clinique fun for over two decades, using for more than 15 years city block spf 40, every single day both in the city as well as on the beach ..it was wonderful, giving a radiance to your skin without it looking oily , it was a substitute of a make up due to its lightly bronzing- skin equalising effect ... Bringing great protection It's orange substitute is an opposite to it. My skin is normal to dry these days but this new city block spf 50 leaves it oily, sticky , very heavy, the cream is dense and even difficult to wash out with a soap so sticky it is... I do not recommend and deeply regret the old version that was a huge success is out of market :(
My skin is combination and I've used it several times with each making my skin oily. Waisted $$

extraits.titre: Holy Grail for mature sensitive skin
extraits.texte: This sunscreen it THE BEST. I apply it in the morning over my vitamin C serum, and it acts as moisturizer and sunscreen. I don't need an additional moisturizer, and I have dry skin - yet, it feels not greasy. It dials down my redness and feels so soothing. I have very fair skin, and I am outside with my dogs a lot. I never experienced burning or redness, this sunscreen protects very well. I will use this forever.

I use this in addition to my moisture surge. I love the hydration of moisture surge and love the finish of this sunblock. Everybody I have let try (varying skin types and shades) has looked amazing after using this. Your skin will look more evenly textured and smooth after using this. Its like wearing makeup, but you're not and it looks super natural. It also works fantastic under make up. Great primer. I have rosacea and acne prone skin that is sensitive and out of all of the products I have ever tried, this and moisture surge hydrate and protect the best. I have dry combination skin.

I'm a male with oily sensitive acne prone skin. I love this spf! It absorbs really nicely with a soft matte finish that lasts. I was afraid it would be heavy or noticeable but is disappears into skin and great protection in full sun.

I was given the sunscreen by my mom try, but after a few weeks of using it I notices it made my skin extremely dry. It also caused my make up to separate even when allowing 15 minutes to dry before applying foundation. I've increased my moisturizer usage hoping that would help offset the dryness, but it has not helped at all. This sunscreen has an odd smell to it.

I got this product and use this for couple of years, no more dark spots or hyper-pigments appear on my face, even I am a dog person and need to go walk my dog under the sun often. A bit thick cream, but it never causes me a pimple or break out.
